feature_descriptions.baseline_rmse_norm: RANSAC word-baseline residual RMSE normalized by x-height h
feature_descriptions.baseline_slope_mean: Mean baseline slope across lines within sentence
feature_descriptions.baseline_slope_std: Standard deviation of baseline slopes across lines (NaN if < 2 lines). EXCLUDED from model feature set (81% NaN — most sentences span a single line).
feature_descriptions.rule_offset_mean: Mean vertical offset of words from nearest ruling line, normalized by spacing r
feature_descriptions.rule_offset_std: Standard deviation of vertical rule offset (vertical adherence jitter)
feature_descriptions.slant_mean_deg: Doubled-angle circular mean slant angle of near-vertical strokes (deg)
feature_descriptions.slant_circular_std_deg: Doubled-angle circular standard deviation of stroke slant (deg)
feature_descriptions.jerk_proxy: Mean |d(kappa)/ds| * h^2 dimensionless jerk proxy from Savitzky-Golay smoothed paths
feature_descriptions.tangent_variance_short_wavelength: Fraction of stroke tangent-angle variance at wavelengths < 0.5h (tremor)
feature_descriptions.kappa_sign_changes_per_h: Curvature sign flips with deadband per h of stroke path
feature_descriptions.tortuosity_median: Median stroke path length divided by chord length
feature_descriptions.gap_mean: Mean inter-word gap normalized by x-height h
feature_descriptions.gap_cv: Coefficient of variation (std / mean) of inter-word gaps
feature_descriptions.word_height_cv: Coefficient of variation of word bounding-box heights within sentence
feature_descriptions.h_over_r: Ratio of x-height h to ruled line spacing r (macro/micrographia)
feature_descriptions.word_width_per_char: Total word width divided by expected prompt character count (copy/dictation)
feature_descriptions.component_height_cv: Mean intra-word connected component height CV
feature_descriptions.ascender_descender_ratio: English: (ascender + descender height) relative to x-height h
feature_descriptions.matra_ratio: Hindi: (upper matra + lower matra height) relative to core band h
feature_descriptions.shirorekha_rms_deviation_norm: Hindi: RMS deviation of shirorekha headline from straight line / h
feature_descriptions.shirorekha_breaks_per_word: Hindi: mean count of headline breaks/discontinuities per word
feature_descriptions.shirorekha_tilt_var: Hindi: variance of headline slopes across words
feature_descriptions.components_per_unit_width: Connected ink components count divided by (sentence_width / h)
feature_descriptions.junctions_per_unit_width: Skeleton branch junctions count divided by (sentence_width / h)
feature_descriptions.endpoints_per_unit_width: Skeleton endpoints count divided by (sentence_width / h)
feature_descriptions.words_written_ratio: Detected word count divided by expected prompt word count
feature_descriptions.lines_used: Number of physical handwritten lines used by sentence
feature_descriptions.stroke_width_mean_norm: Mean stroke thickness normalized by x-height h
feature_descriptions.stroke_width_cv: Coefficient of variation of stroke thickness along skeleton centerline
feature_descriptions.stroke_width_jitter: Mean normalized step difference |w_{k+1} - w_k| / mean(w) along stroke paths
feature_descriptions.stroke_width_pinch_rate: Fraction of skeleton points with thickness < 0.5 * mean(w) (stroke pinching)
feature_descriptions.stroke_width_bloat_rate: Fraction of skeleton points with thickness > 1.5 * mean(w) (hesitation bloats)
feature_descriptions.pressure_intensity_mean: Mean optical density along skeleton (0.0=white paper, 1.0=black ink)
feature_descriptions.pressure_intensity_cv: Coefficient of variation of pencil pressure along skeleton centerline
feature_descriptions.pressure_gradient_mean: Mean normalized local pressure step difference along stroke paths
feature_descriptions.pressure_faint_rate: Fraction of stroke points with faint pressure (<0.75 * mean)
feature_descriptions.pressure_heavy_rate: Fraction of stroke points with heavy digging pressure (>1.25 * mean)
feature_descriptions.pressure_width_corr: Spearman rank correlation between local thickness and optical density
feature_descriptions.smudge_halo_darkness: Mean optical density of graphite smearing in the non-ink halo ring surrounding words
feature_descriptions.background_roughness_std: Grayscale standard deviation in non-ink halo ring (paper abrasion/texture)
feature_descriptions.erasure_patch_ratio: Fraction of halo pixels significantly darker than clean background paper
